plugin.name: CELLULA
plugin.description: Nine 64-cell automata as rhythm, wavetable and FFT mask; sine/click datamatics voice with bit-matrix and barcode screens

Clock: Tempo (master bars: BPM = bars x 2, > 25 runs, > 10 DAC on)
Rows: Pitch (bars added to every PITCH row)
Gate (bars taken from every DECAY row: + = longer notes)
Automata: Mutate all (one generation per unlocked voice)
